purpose: Isolate initial versus actual-future sparse support with initial-only feature transfer
residual_initialization: zero residual around spatially transferred initial features; exact overlap then deterministic nearest initial cell
bounded_equation: F0 + a*tanh(R/a), a=3*std; equals original F0+a*tanh(U), U=R/a
parameter_units: feature units; equal initial Jacobian on nonzero-std channels
support: Complete actual future coordinates; oracle support diagnostic, not a predicted occupancy set
native_codec: original baseline, all parameters and buffers frozen, eval, native hard pruning
loss: real-view full MAE + hand ROI MAE + (10/9)*motion weighted MAE; no auxiliary, teacher, or temporal term
secondary_view: evaluation against existing native-GS teacher only; no training supervision
checkpoint_selection: fixed final step 600, no best-frame selection
failure_policy: stop failing worker, preserve error and all records; no retries, truncation, or automatic architecture changes
engineering_acceptance: four 600-step fits; initial-only coordinate transfer verified; finite nonzero feature gradient; all codec tensors unchanged; 10 native packets / 20 views replay
scientific_acceptance: visual confirmation of yellow-bar vertical pose at frame44 and crossbar spanning pillars at frame132; RGB and fixed color proxies are supporting diagnostics only
limitations: Oracle future coordinates, two known TRAIN endpoints, larger support may change parameter count and feature initialization; no action code, temporal consistency, AR or generalization claim; optimization failure is not proof of impossibility
feature_initialization: Only F0 is transferred to C_future; no F_future values enter the optimization initialization
